Questions 1-4 refer to the following letter.

Dear Ms. Joseph,

I am writing in reference to the partnership proposal that you sent to HF Manufacturers on 8 March. I am pleased to inform you that our Vice President, Mr. Howard, would like to meet with representatives from your company to discuss the proposal in more detail.

Mr. Howard will be away on business until 18 March, so he suggests holding the meeting on 20 March at 10:00 A.M. in our head office. If this date does not suit you, please let us know two or three alternative dates and we will do our best to accommodate them.

Because this meeting is crucial to our first cooperation, our finance advisor, Ms. Lee, will also attend. We would appreciate it if you could bring the cost estimates and the delivery schedule mentioned in your proposal. All other necessary paperwork will be prepared by our legal team.

Please confirm your attendance by replying to this letter or by calling my office at 555-0142 before 15 March.

Sincerely,
Daniel Brooks
Business Development Manager
HF Manufacturers

1. What is the purpose of the letter?
(A) To ask for details of a proposal
(B) To arrange a business meeting
(C) To request a new business proposal
(D) To sign a partnership agreement

2. When does Mr. Howard suggest holding the meeting?
(A) On 8 March
(B) On 15 March
(C) On 18 March
(D) On 20 March

3. Who will also attend the meeting?
(A) A legal advisor
(B) A finance advisor
(C) A delivery manager
(D) Ms. Joseph's assistant

4. What is Ms. Joseph asked to bring?
(A) A signed contract
(B) A list of alternative dates
(C) Cost estimates and a delivery schedule
(D) Paperwork from the legal team

Answer key: 1B 2D 3B 4C
